skill.name: clarify
skill.description: Rewrite unclear UX copy, error messages, labels, instructions, and microcopy so interfaces are easier to understand.
skill.summary: Clarifies interface copy so users understand what happened and what to do next.
skill.author: pbakaus

security_audit.summary: The only static finding is a false positive. SKILL.md line 59 contains a sample bad error message, not system reconnaissance or host inspection.

finding_verdicts.reason: The phrase is a UX writing example in the Error Messages section, paired with a clearer replacement. It does not request environment discovery, host inspection, or system reconnaissance.

content.value_statement: Unclear interface text slows users and creates avoidable support requests. This skill helps rewrite labels, errors, buttons, and help text in plain language.
actual_capabilities: Review error messages and explain why they are unclear.
Rewrite labels, placeholders, tooltips, and button text with specific actions.
Improve empty states, success messages, loading states, and confirmation dialogs.
Check tone against audience knowledge, user state, and product context.
Verify copy for comprehension, actionability, brevity, consistency, and tone.
limitations: It depends on accurate product context and audience details from the user.
It does not perform live usability testing or measure support ticket changes.
It cannot guarantee brand voice alignment without brand guidelines.
It is not a full localization or legal review tool.

use_cases.title: Clean Up Product Error Messages
use_cases.description: Turn vague or technical errors into plain language that explains the problem and next step.

use_cases.title: Review Form Labels and Help Text
use_cases.description: Improve form copy so users know what to enter, why it matters, and how formats should look.

use_cases.title: Standardize Interface Terminology
use_cases.description: Find inconsistent labels, buttons, and navigation terms across a product workflow.

prompt_templates.title: Clarify One Message
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a single unclear string.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use clarify on this error message: "Invalid input". The audience is first-time users. Make it clear and actionable.

prompt_templates.title: Improve a Form Flow
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review of labels and help text.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use clarify to review the labels and help text in this signup form: [paste copy]. The audience is small business owners. Keep each line concise.

prompt_templates.title: Audit State Messages
prompt_templates.prompt: Use clarify to improve these empty states, loading messages, and success messages: [paste copy]. Explain the issue with each line. Then provide revised copy.

prompt_templates.title: Refine Critical Action Copy
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review with tone and space constraints.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use clarify on this destructive action dialog: [paste copy]. The product tone is calm and direct. Buttons must fit 18 characters. Include safer alternatives.

output_examples.output: Email addresses need an @ symbol. Try an address like name@example.com.
No projects yet. Create your first project to get started.

best_practices: Provide audience, workflow state, and character limits before asking for rewrites.
Ask for the reason behind each change when you need review notes.
Check final copy in the real interface to confirm fit and context.
anti_patterns: Do not ask it to invent product facts or policies that users must rely on.
Do not use vague instructions like make this better without context.
Do not accept playful error copy for stressful or high-risk moments.

faq.question: What kind of copy can this skill improve?
faq.answer: It can improve errors, form labels, buttons, help text, tooltips, empty states, success messages, and confirmations.

faq.question: Does it change UI layouts?
faq.answer: It focuses on words. It can flag copy placement issues, but it does not redesign full layouts.

faq.question: Can it write for nontechnical audiences?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide the audience and product context so the skill can remove jargon and explain terms clearly.

faq.question: Does it require screenshots?
faq.answer: No. Screenshots help when layout, sequence, or surrounding text affects the meaning.

faq.question: Can it audit many messages at once?
faq.answer: Yes. Group related messages by workflow so the skill can keep terminology consistent.

faq.question: Is it safe to use with private product details?
faq.answer: Share only details your organization allows in your AI tool. The skill file contains no network or file access.
